entities.name: Achtep Keep
entities.description: Capital fortress of the Order of the Ebon Hand in the Western Marshes, seat of Tourach's priesthood.

entities.name: Order of the Ebon Hand
entities.description: Order that worshipped Tourach and bred thrulls.

entities.name: Tourach
entities.description: Founder and primary deity of the Order.

entities.name: Thurzen Klathe
entities.description: Lord High Priest of the Order of the Ebon Hand.

entities.name: Genkr Nik
entities.description: Ruler of the Keep who tortures Reod.

entities.name: Reod Dai
entities.description: Captive who knew goblin bomb secrets and started a thrull rebellion.

entities.name: Sarya Haasendel
entities.description: Dwarf stranded after the fall of Gurn Keep.

entities.name: Ivra Jursdotter
entities.description: Mercenary sent south who joined the orcs.

entities.name: Thrull rebellion
entities.description: Uprising that overwhelmed the Ebon Hand.

events.summary: In 170 AR an agent of Genkr Nik captures Reod Dai and brings him to Achtep Keep.
events.quote: an agent of Genkr Nik captured Reod Dai and brought him to Achtep Keep

events.summary: Reod plans a thrull rebellion; some thrulls betray him and Genkr tortures him.
events.quote: Reod then hatched a plan to start a thrull rebellion.

events.summary: The rebellion starts and Eliza frees Reod, taking him to the Crimson Peaks.
events.quote: allowing Eliza to free Reod and bring him to the Crimson Peaks

events.summary: Thurzen sends Ivra Jursdotter to the dwarves, but she joins the orcs, sealing the dwarves' doom.
The thrull rebellion overwhelms the Ebon Hand, leaving Achtep Keep in ruin.
events.quote: the thrull rebellion eventually overwhelmed them completely, leaving Achtep Keep in ruin

relations.quote: The Order of the Ebon Hand and their Citadel were both founded by Tourach
Thurzen Klathe oversaw this site as the Lord High Priest of the Order of the Ebon Hand.
the captial fortress belonging to the Order of the Ebon Hand
